name: The Magma King
description: the Warden of the Ember Wastes: a hulking demon king made of cooling black slag and cracked obsidian with molten orange lava glowing through the cracks, a jagged crown of volcanic rock fused to his head, a heavy cloak of dripping lava, burning eyes, slouched and bored like he has ruled this place forever

poses.stand: hovering a little above the ground on a cushion of heat haze and embers, arms folded
poses.dead: cracking apart and collapsing into a heap of cooling slag and smoke

idle.action: hovers in place, breathing slowly, lava pulsing through his cracks, cloak dripping

move.action: glides forward to the right on the heat haze, cloak trailing, staying in the same spot in the frame

attack.action: draws his arms back and flings them forward, hurling a spray of molten fireballs to the right, then folds his arms again

hurt.action: is struck and reels back, lava spurting from a crack in his chest, then straightens up again

die.action: roars, cracks split across his body, and he collapses into a smoking heap of slag
